items.title: HiringNow
items.source_text: HiringNow AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else. HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval. Every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also: resume builder and mock interviews. Free plan with 10 auto-applies. Productivity Artificial Intelligence Career

items.title: Dex Semantics
items.source_text: Dex Semantics Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors Dex Semantics adds declarations to your analytical models, which capture row meaning, join nature, how numbers add up, and decisional assumptions. Thanks to this, Dex scores 80% on ADE-bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared to 73.3% without Dex (25% fewer tasks failed). Declarations live in your models as code, not a third-party tool. Dex then helps your agent convert declarations into your Semantic Layer of choice. Analytics Developer Tools GitHub Data & Analytics

items.title: Rakazo
items.source_text: Rakazo The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own Rakazo gives you AI teammates that keep working after you close the chat. Each bot has its own memory, routines and computer, with a browser you can watch and take over. Open source and self-hosted: any model, your keys, your machine. Web, desktop and mobile. Android Productivity Open Source Artificial Intelligence GitHub

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5
items.source_text: Gemini Robotics 2.5 Gemini Robotics 2.5: Google’s most capable robot model Gemini Robotics 2.5 is Google DeepMind’s most capable vision-language-action model, turning what a robot sees and is told into hand and arm movements. Per DeepMind, it has a 30% to 100% higher success rate than the previous baseline, finishes tasks 20% to 30% faster, and reached 96% success in a Mercedes-Benz parts-kitting pilot with Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid. Works across robot types. Rolling out to robotics partners. Artificial Intelligence GitHub YouTube
